item.title: Here’s what to pay attention to at the UNGA
item.description: World leaders arrive for UNGA 81 as wars multiply and trust erodes in global institutions. Emma Withrow explains.

item.title: Trump returns to the UN, what will he say?
item.description: Trump returns to UNGA amid Iran war he started, Israeli violations of a Gaza ceasefire, and scrutiny of US aims.

item.title: UK to refuel Saudi jets to help counter Houthi attacks
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he has agreed to a request for 'defensive' air-to-air refuelling of Saudi jets.

item.title: Typhoon Dujuan kills two in Japan, causes travel chaos near Tokyo
item.description: Storm is moving northeast away from Japan's eastern coast into the Pacific, leaving a path of destruction behind.

item.title: Morocco’s youth take Gen Z protest demands to the polls
item.description: Young candidates hope the election can turn youth frustration into political participation.

item.title: Mali marks independence amid a worsening security crisis
item.description: The 66th anniversary comes as armed groups expand their reach and the government struggles to secure key supply routes.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says US, Israel ‘must accept withdrawal’ from region
item.description: The IRGC says the US and Israel "must accept the region's freedom from their vile and criminal presence".

item.title: How thousands of migrants stranded in Ceuta are surviving
item.description: Authorities estimate that at least 10,000 people remain in the enclave of Ceuta after a record surge in July.

item.title: Former ‘death squad’ leader appears in military trial in The Gambia
item.description: Sanna Manjang faces court for deserting army in 2017 after end of Jammeh's 20-year rule.

item.title: Trump speech inaudible as US networks boycott White House event
item.description: US President Trump unveiled a new White House helicopter pad as major US TV networks stayed away in protest.

item.title: Putin’s party wins supermajority in Russia’s parliamentary election
item.description: Victory of United Russia party strengthens Putin's hand even as the war with Ukraine grows more unpopular.

item.title: UN Chief Guterres calls for ban on ‘killer robots’
item.description: In this episode of On the Record, UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls for ban on autonomous ‘killer robots’.

item.title: US man convicted in 2023 shooting of three Palestinian students in Vermont
item.description: Jason Eaton faces up to life in prison after a jury rejected his insanity defence.

item.title: FAA halts flights to major US East Coast airports amid outage
item.description: FAA halts East Coast flights due to equipment outage, affecting major US airports like JFK, Newark, and Philadelphia.

item.title: Embattled Gianni Infantino says he is open to talks over FIFA reform
item.description: FIFA president proposes 'consultation' with members to reform world football governing body's decision-making process.

item.title: UK prosecutors charge first person for Rwanda genocide
item.description: Vincent Brown is 'alleged to have directed and incited acts of murder and genocide carried out by others'.

item.title: Protesters blockade Elbit Systems factory over Israel weapons supply
item.description: Nine protesters blocked access to Elbit Systems’ factory in Staffordshire by attaching themselves to five ‘lock-ons’.

item.title: Trump approval rating hits career low of 32% amid Iran war, high costs
item.description: Republican support for Trump dips to 73 percent, down from 82 percent, as war and inflation concerns dominate polls.

item.title: Photos: Gaza’s children return to class in tents and ruins
item.description: Gaza children return to classrooms after three years, facing challenges of damaged schools, tents, and scarce supplies.

item.title: Protesters march on Islamabad over soaring fuel prices
item.description: Pakistan’s Jamaat-e-Islami party has launched a protest march towards Islamabad over soaring fuel prices.

item.title: Ceuta solidarity shirt row: How the crisis engulfed Spanish football
item.description: Football has been dragged into growing tensions over the influx of migrants from Morocco to the Spanish enclave Ceuta.

item.title: Paramount settles with US states, union to win Warner Bros takeover
item.description: Ellison-led Paramount will avoid daily $7m fee if the $110bn Warner Bros merger closes by September 30.

item.title: ‘Licence to kill:’ French protests decry police use-of-force bill
item.description: Thousands of protesters across France rallied against a new law they say will give police a "licence to kill”.

item.title: Airplane makes ‘miracle’ landing as Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
item.description: A plane landing in Tokyo that one passenger called 'a miracle' ended with applause as Typhoon Dujuan battered Japan.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Ben-Gvir demands death penalty for Palestinian who killed
item.description: Jerusalem Daily: Ben-Gvir demands death penalty for Palestinian who killed settler
